13520.d: The herb patch at Trollheim is a type of Farming patch which require at least 1 herb seed to plant starting at level 9.
13520.ex: You can grow herbs in this Farming patch.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• The Trollheim Farm Teleport (a Lunar spell) teleports the player directly to the patch. To use this spell, players must first unlock it through Livid Farm. Casting it requires a Magic level of 92.
• Trollheim farm teleport tablets can be used regardless of Magic Level, but still requires Lunar Diplomacy, My Arm's Big Adventure, and the Livid Farm unlock to use. These can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or bought on the Grand Exchange.
• The Trollheim Teleport in the standard spellbook teleports the player to a large hill to the east of the Troll Stronghold. The mountain can be descended through a series of pathways, or more quickly via agility shortcuts. Level 61 Magic and completion of the Eadgar's Ruse quest are required to cast this spell. Low-level players should be wary of the aggressive mountain trolls around the entrance to the Troll Stronghold; they can hit relatively hard and must be run past to reach the entrance of the stronghold and then throughout it until the ladder can be reached.
• A less click-heavy alternative to this route is to use a ring of slaying or the fairy ring (code AJR) to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon entrance. Be sure to bring rock climbing boots; they are required to cross the small rock wall. Head east, over the rocks and then north to the secret entrance. Enter and go to the other end of the troll jail, up the stairs, through the door and up the next stairs. Run south to enter the western part of the cave and up the "troll ladder" to the roof of the troll stronghold, and then to the patch. This route is slightly longer, about 1 minute 36 seconds, but does not require runes or a high magic level.

13531.d: Herby Werby is a weekly Distraction and Diversion located on Anachronia, involving the Herblore and Firemaking skills.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Teleport to Herby Werby using an ancient seed (costs 50 potent herbs), or follow the map to get to the entrance of Herby Werby.

Alternatively, use the Eastern Anachronia Teleport (level 78 Magic required) in the standard spells and then run north.

The fastest route from the Anachronia Base Camp shown requires level 70 Agility to traverse part of the advanced section of the Anachronia Agility Course. Level 50 Agility is required to enter the Agility course at all.

If players don't have level 70 Agility, walk north instead of crossing the bones, then east a little, then south under the bones, then east a little, then north to the Tree roots.

If players don't have level 50 Agility, similarly exit the base camp at the northwest corner and follow the grassy area to the east until entering the Herby Werby area from the south.

13553.d: The Heroes' Guild is located between Taverley and Burthorpe.

gt.heading: Transportation
gt.text:
The Heroes' Guild is to the north of Taverley and to the south of Burthorpe. Several quick means of transportation are available:
• Players may teleport to their player-owned house in Taverley using the House Teleport spell. It will only work if the player's house is located in Taverley or if the player uses a chipped house teleport.
• Use the Home Teleport spell to teleport to Burthorpe and run south-east, or to Taverley and run north.
• A games necklace can teleport players to the Burthorpe Troll Invasion area. Each necklace has eight charges.
• A combat bracelet can teleport players to the Warriors' Guild in western Burthorpe.
• The balloon transport system can be used to fly to Taverley. Using the balloons requires at least partial completion of the Enlightened Journey quest.
• The Quest Cape or Master quest cape can teleport the player next to the Fountain of Heroes

13569.d: Het's Oasis is a skilling area featuring Agility, Farming, and Hunter activities, as well as two quests progressing the Elder God Wars narrative.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
To access the north side and start of the Agility course:
• Teleport directly to Het's Oasis western entrance by using a ring of duelling.
• Teleport to the fire altar using a fire altar teleport tablet.
• Teleport to the Al Kharid mine or Garden of Kharid by using the dungeoneering cape, sand seed, or mystical sand seed and go south.
To access the south side:
• Teleport to the Kharid-et Dig Site by using the master archaeologist's outfit, an archaeology teleport, or using the dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild and go north.
• Teleport to Al Kharid by using the Lodestone Network and go north-east.
It is possible to move between the two areas on arrival, however the area is quite large and it is not possible to move through the middle of the Oasis.

13629.d: Hill giants may be encountered while training Dungeoneering.

13638.d: Hingy is an essence impling that can be found sitting atop a bookshelf in Daffyd's house within the Amlodd district of Prifddinas after an essence impling is caught elsewhere using the Hunter skill.

13639.d: Hired adventurers are people found in north-east portion of the Varrock Dig Site during Breaking the Storm event.

start.label: Varrock Dig Site

13640.d: Hirko is a dwarven merchant that runs a market stall on the east side of Keldagrim, the capital of the dwarves.

13641.d: Hisamitsu is a seafarer in the Port district of Menaphos.
13641.ex: A seafarer from the Eastern Lands.

13642.d: Historian Seth Minas is a Varrock Museum employee who can be found managing the history exhibits on the floor 2 of Varrock Museum, near the staircase.

13644.d: Hitching post is a scenery object located north of Draynor Village.

13645.d: Hiylik Myna is a Saradominist priest, and one of the few surviving members of the Saradominist Order of Paterdomus.
13645.ex: A local holy man who supports the people trying to get though Mort Myre.

13646.d: Hm Val is a player spoof who could be seen playing Pest Control during the Gnomecopter Tours.

13647.d: Hobbes is the butler of Lord Sinclair and his family at the Sinclair Mansion, and is very loyal to the family.
13647.ex: He looks kind of stuck up...

13648.d: Hobgoblins are Bandosian creatures that share characteristics with both goblins and orks.
